title: Accept compact worker cache messages
pr_body: Changes the worker cache from JSON text to a compact binary payload and adds a decoder.
author: codex
provenance: Original synthetic production-style change authored for benchmark v2.

bugs.title: Worker executes untrusted pickle payloads
bugs.rationale: Cache messages originate from a queue that accepts tenant-submitted work. pickle.loads can execute attacker-selected constructors during decoding, before the dictionary type check.
